build: Android assembleRom and Astro production build passed on the release tree.
commands: Astro dev server on a throwaway libSQL file with a simulated provider: Pocket's client transport in Node (this release and the previous transport) and an isolated Edge Pip tab

apk.signing: Requires the existing Pocket release certificate; handled by the signing agent

web.browser: isolated Edge, fictional account, simulated provider, throwaway libSQL file
flows: Signed-in Pip tab: the notes lookup showed 1.1 s into a 3.4 s server reply, the answer at 3.4 s, marked on Pocket's server
Client transport against the dev server: lookup shown at 0.9 s of 3.3 s; the previous transport showed nothing until 3.26 s
Approval on the server: after approving, the save showed queued at 1.0 s and done at 1.5 s, answer at 3.9 s; each approved note saved once

known_limits: Unsigned APK must be signed before installation or update.
Android code is unchanged since 0.21.0; no physical handset was attached.
Streaming was checked on the local Astro dev server, not on Vercel. A host that cannot stream falls back to asking every 700 ms.
A server run reaches a watching tab through the database at most every 700 ms, so text arrives in steps rather than token by token.
The phone does not follow a server run live or settle its approvals; it receives the reply through account sync.
A tab showing an approval card does not notice that another browser settled it until its own card is answered.
